links.outcome: Neurologist and radiologist diagnostic accuracy and decision time with versus without the AI agent
links.effect: Agent improved neurologist and radiologist accuracy by 6%-11% and more than halved decision time in a controlled reader study; overreliance not reported in the abstract.
links.quote: In a controlled reader study, the agent improved neurologist and radiologist accuracy by 6%-11% and more than halved decision time.

links.outcome: Performance disparities across racial and age subgroups
links.effect: AD-CARE decreased average dispersion of four metrics by 21%-68% across racial subgroups and 28%-51% across age subgroups, so disparities were reduced but not eliminated.
links.quote: AD-CARE reduced performance disparities across racial and age subgroups, decreasing the average dispersion of four metrics by 21%-68% and 28%-51%, respectively.

unlisted_practices: Modality-agnostic agent design that handles missing modalities without imputation
Embedding clinical guidelines into LLM reasoning for report-style diagnostic output

screen.reason: Evaluates a novel guideline-grounded LLM agent framework (AD-CARE) for Alzheimer's diagnosis across multi-cohort benchmarks and a controlled reader study with clinicians (neurologists and radiologists).
